A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated that the TB-PCR assay is a useful diagnostic tool for the detection of M. tuberculosis in HIV-infected patients with pulmonary and extrapulmonary tuberculosis, and can be used to monitor treatment efficacy in patients with pulmonary and extra-pulmonary tuberculosis.

we have shown that a simple, rapid, and inexpensive molecular diagnostic test for TB, the Xpert® MTB/RIF assay, is a highly accurate test for TB and drug resistance in HIV-infected individuals, and that it has the potential to be adapted to use in critically ill patients with TB and HIV.
